Boundaries.Name: fan-out
Boundaries.Contract: Keep public fan-out ownership through endpoint discovery, all target outcomes and cleanup. Public facet validation remains in its enclosing declared owner.

Boundaries.Name: fan-out-target
Boundaries.Contract: Each target keeps its per-node returned failure through converter and pool cleanup. Parent aggregates outcomes; do not publish the same node failure as both target and parent.

NonRoutes.Reason: Local value construction, validation, formatting, comparison or state inspection; no command dispatch.
